control_failures.control_label: exclusion of people from beneath elevated work
preparation and approval of a lift study

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: kinetic release during routine operation on P-9501

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on P-9501 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically selecting and inspecting lifting gear. P-9501 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during routine operation while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 14 April 2026 an incident occurred on P-9501 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
